Subject: Selwyn Table & Tap - Quote Request

Hi Leon,

Thanks for the submission on Selwyn Table & Tap! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary cuisine type and whether they serve alcohol at both locations?
- What are the building construction types and protection classes for each location?
- Are there any cooking operations that involve open flame or solid fuel?
- Has there been any recent renovation work, and are the fire suppression systems up to date?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive quote for you.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
